quote: First systematic study of word-representable graphs, which introduced representation numbers and the classification problem for graphs with representation number 3
note: The problem of classifying graphs with representation number 3 originated with the foundational 2008 paper by Kitaev and Pyatkin that began the systematic study of word-representable graphs and introduced the concept of representation numbers. A dedicated 2013 paper by Kitaev titled 'On graphs with representation number 3' represents the state-of-the-art work on this classification problem.
